verdict.rationale: Lambda's offerings are all always-on GPU instances, 1-Click Clusters, Managed Kubernetes, and Slurm clusters billed hourly/by minute — there is no evidence of a serverless, autoscale-to-zero GPU worker model. In fact, community evidence shows the opposite: idle GH200 instances kept accruing charges with no auto-stop capability, and support explicitly stated 'Lambda does not distinguish between idle and in use instance states.'
